step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's return on capital employed (ROCE) for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report percentages rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.gt_template:
ROCE is Operating Income divided by Capital Employed.
For 2026:
Capital Employed = Total Assets - Current Liabilities = $[[Assets@FY2026]] million - $[[CurLiab@FY2026]] million = $[[Assets@FY2026 - CurLiab@FY2026]] million
ROCE = $[[OpInc@FY2026]] million / $[[Assets@FY2026 - CurLiab@FY2026]] million = [[ROCE@FY2026|.1f]]%
For 2025:
Capital Employed = $[[Assets@FY2025]] million - $[[CurLiab@FY2025]] million = $[[Assets@FY2025 - CurLiab@FY2025]] million
ROCE = $[[OpInc@FY2025]] million / $[[Assets@FY2025 - CurLiab@FY2025]] million = [[ROCE@FY2025|.1f]]%
ROCE [[!ROCE_change]] from [[ROCE@FY2025|.1f]]% in 2025 to [[ROCE@FY2026|.1f]]% in 2026.
